title: German Style Crumble
description: A classic German dessert with a crunchy oat topping and a rich, yeasty center. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the oat, yeasty, and german.
In a separate bowl, combine the crumble and a pinch of salt.
Add the crumble mixture to the oat mixture and mix until crumbly.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
While the mixture is baking, prepare the topping by mixing together 1/2 cup of crumble and 1/4 cup of oat.
After the 25 minutes, remove the baking dish from the oven and top with the crumble-oat mixture.
Return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
